title: Ali Baba part 1 text and questions
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Ali Baba and the forty thieves; occasions
source: Written for arabic/y6 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ali Baba part 1 text and questions)
intro: Lesson 9: Reading: Ali Baba and the forty thieves (part 1). Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
كَانَ عَلِي بَابَا حَطَّابًا فَقِيرًا.
ذَهَبَ إِلَى الغَابَةِ لِيَجْمَعَ الحَطَبَ.
رَأَى أَرْبَعِينَ لِصًّا عِنْدَ مَغَارَةٍ.
قَالَ رَئِيسُ اللُّصُوصِ: اِفْتَحْ يَا سِمْسِمُ!
فَانْفَتَحَ بَابُ المَغَارَةِ، وَدَخَلَ اللُّصُوصُ.

panels.title: Meaning
points: Ali Baba was a poor woodcutter
He saw forty thieves at a cave
Their leader said 'Open, sesame!' and the door opened

questions.q: What was Ali Baba's job? Answer in Arabic.
Reading questions on the pupil PDF: five questions (three in Arabic), then find and copy every past-tense verb in part 1.
questions.a: Woodcutter; forest; forty thieves; open sesame; the door opened. Verbs: كَانَ، ذَهَبَ، رَأَى، قَالَ، انْفَتَحَ، دَخَلَ

questions.q: Extend: predict what Ali Baba will do next (one Arabic sentence).
questions.a: For example: سَيَدْخُلُ المَغَارَةَ (he will enter the cave)

questions.q: Stretch: why do you think the story uses a secret password?
questions.a: It keeps the treasure hidden; only those who know the words can enter.
A) أَرْبَعُونَ (40). أَرْبَعِينَ لِصًّا: forty thieves.

questions.q: Think again: what should you do with treasure that isn't yours?
questions.a: Return it or hand it to the authorities.
